late_cut_note: kind `cut` is the Late Login Policy cut in days, from the same rule payroll applies (only on days paid as worked, never on leave); `payable` is net of it, and UNPAID_LEAVE (LOP) carries no weight, so this Payable figure is the one payroll pays over calendar days (8 Oct).
note: REPORTS → Attendance summary. One row per employee (or per company / branch / department / designation / team when grouped) over any period — month, year, financial year, YTD, MTD or custom dates — from the same muster the attendance report shows. `columns` are everything the screen can show; the viewer ticks which. kind `status` counts the days whose classified status is `status` (the statuses come from config/attendance-rules.json; a status the rules never produce simply shows 0). kind `measure` reads the muster totals: `days` = calendar days in the period that have happened, `worked_hours` / `break_hours` / `late_hours` / `overtime_hours` are minutes shown as HH:MM, `late_days` and `regularisation` are day counts. kind `payable` is the sum of the status columns in `payable_statuses` with their weights (a half day is half a day) — the figure payroll's calendar-days method needs. `default_columns` are ticked when the screen opens. `chart_statuses` are the statuses drawn in the bar chart, with their colours.
